instruction.name: xvssrln.hu.w
instruction.description: Logical right shift each unsigned 32-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 32, saturate the result to unsigned 16-bit, write it into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.
